# ConstruGestión — Blueprint
**Generated by The Architect · Archetype: Internal Tool / Enterprise Backend**
**Project:** Sistema Empresarial de Gestión de Constructora
**Date:** May 2026
**PMI Framework:** PMBOK 6 (Process-Based) + PMBOK 7 (Principle-Based) + PMBOK 8 (Unified, 2024)

---

## Section 1 — Project Overview

### Vision
A single web platform that runs every operational process of a construction company — field logs, heavy equipment, materials inventory, payroll, accounting, contracts — replacing paper, Excel files, and disconnected tools with one integrated system.

### Who It's For
Construction companies that build roads, earthworks, infrastructure, residential, and commercial buildings. Teams ranging from 10 to 500+ workers, operating across multiple simultaneous projects.

### Core User Problems Solved
- Field engineers waste 45+ min/day writing paper daily logs with no traceability
- Inventory managers can't know real stock levels — materials get lost or double-ordered
- Equipment hours are tracked in Excel — fuel costs and maintenance are unknown
- Payroll is calculated manually with ~5% error rate, violating Colombian labor law
- Managers have zero real-time visibility into project costs vs. budget

### Success Metrics
| Metric | Baseline | Target |
|--------|----------|--------|
| Daily log entry time | 45 min | < 10 min |
| Inventory discrepancy | ~20% | < 2% |
| Payroll errors | ~5% | < 0.5% |
| Monthly accounting close | 5 days | < 1 day |
| Cost visibility latency | Weekly | Real-time |

### Project Scope (MVP)
9 functional modules: Projects, Daily Logs, Equipment, Warehouse, Personnel, Payroll, Accounting, Administration, Dashboard. Web-only, desktop-first. Colombian business rules (labor law, tax codes, accounting plan).

### PMI Value Delivery Framework

This system is a **value delivery component** in the organization's portfolio. Following PMBOK 7 and 8 principles, business value is measured across three horizons:

| Horizon | Measure | PMBOK Domain |
|---------|---------|--------------|
| Output | Software deployed and operational | Delivery |
| Outcome | Teams adopt the platform (>80% usage in 60 days) | Stakeholders |
| Benefit | Operational costs reduced ≥15% in 6 months | Measurement |

**Benefits Realization** (PMBOK 8 — Focus Area: Beneficios):
- Benefit Owner: Gerente General
- Realization Window: 6–12 months post go-live
- Tracking Mechanism: Dashboard KPIs (cost variance, log completion rate, payroll accuracy)

**OPAs (Organizational Process Assets) consumed by this project:**
- Colombian construction labor law templates (payroll rules)
- Company chart of accounts (PUC — Plan Único de Cuentas)
- Existing equipment maintenance checklists

**EEFs (Enterprise Environmental Factors) that constrain this project:**
- DIAN tax regulations (IVA 19%, retención)
- Colombian Social Security contribution rates (ARL, CCF, ICBF, SENA)
- PostgreSQL-only infrastructure already in place

### Stakeholder Register (PMBOK 6 — 13.1 Identify Stakeholders)

| Stakeholder | Role | Power | Interest | Engagement Strategy |
|-------------|------|-------|----------|---------------------|
| Gerente General | Sponsor | High | High | Weekly status, EVM dashboard |
| Director de Obra | Key User | High | High | Module demos, UAT sessions |
| Almacenista | Key User | Low | High | Training, simplified UI |
| Contador | Key User | Medium | High | Chart of accounts review |
| RRHH | Key User | Medium | High | Payroll rule validation |
| Operadores/Conductores | End User | Low | Medium | Mobile-friendly forms (Phase 2) |
| Proveedores | External | Low | Low | Informational only |

## Section 2 — Tech Stack

### Backend
| Technology | Version | Rationale |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| Python | 3.12 | Mature ecosystem, excellent for data-heavy business logic |
| Django | 5.x | Batteries-included ORM, admin panel, migrations — perfect for enterprise CRUD |
| Django REST Framework | 3.17 | Industry standard REST API layer for Django |
| djangorestframework-simplejwt | 5.x | JWT auth with refresh token rotation |
| django-cors-headers | 4.x | CORS for SPA + API separation |
| django-filter | 25.x | Declarative filtering on all list endpoints |
| drf-spectacular | 0.29 | Auto-generates OpenAPI 3.0 / Swagger docs |
| Pillow | 11.x | Image handling for employee/equipment photos |
| python-decouple | 3.x | Environment variable management |
| psycopg2-binary | 2.9 | PostgreSQL driver |
| gunicorn | 23.x | WSGI server for production |

### Database
| Technology | Version | Rationale |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| PostgreSQL | 16 | ACID compliance critical for financial/payroll data. Decimal precision for money. |

### Frontend
| Technology | Version | Rationale |
|-----------|---------|-----------|
| React | 18 | Component model ideal for data-dense admin interfaces |
| TypeScript | 5.x | Type safety essential across 39 data entities |
| Vite | 8.x | Fast HMR, native ESM, optimal build output |
| Tailwind CSS | v4 | Utility-first — fast iteration on dense UI tables/forms |
| TanStack Query | 5.x | Server-state caching, background refetch, optimistic updates |
| Zustand | 4.x | Minimal global state (auth only — everything else is server state) |
| React Router | 6.x | Client-side routing with nested layouts |
| React Hook Form | 7.x | Performant forms with minimal re-renders |
| Zod | 3.x | Schema validation shared between forms and API types |
| Axios | 1.x | HTTP client with JWT interceptors |
| Lucide React | latest | Consistent icon set — 1000+ icons |
| date-fns | 3.x | Date formatting/manipulation for Colombian locale |
| Recharts | 2.x | Charts for dashboard KPIs |

### Infrastructure
| Technology | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|
| Docker | Reproducible environments across dev/staging/prod |
| Docker Compose | Orchestrates PostgreSQL + Django + Nginx locally |
| Nginx | Serves React static build, proxies /api/ to Gunicorn |

## Section 4 — Data Model

### Entity Relationship Overview

```
Client ──────────┐
                 ├──► Contract ◄── Contractor
Project ◄────────┘       │
   │                     │
   ├──► ProjectPhase      │
   ├──► ProjectDocument   │
   ├──► Invoice ──────────┘
   ├──► Expense
   ├──► Budget
   ├──► EquipmentAssignment ──► Equipment
   └──► DailyLog
             ├──► LogActivity
             ├──► LogPersonnel ──► Employee
             ├──► LogEquipment ──► Equipment
             ├──► LogMaterial  ──► Material
             └──► LogIncident

Employee ──► PayrollEntry ◄── PayrollPeriod
Employee ──► SalaryAdvance
Employee ──► Department
Employee ──► Position

Material ──► MaterialCategory
Material ──► MaterialEntry ◄── Supplier
Material ──► MaterialExit
Supplier ──► PurchaseOrder ──► PurchaseOrderItem ──► Material

Account (tree: parent FK to self)
Journal ──► JournalEntry ──► Account
```

### Full SQL Schema

```sql
-- USERS
CREATE TABLE users_user (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(150) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    email VARCHAR(254) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    password VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL,
    first_name VARCHAR(150),
    last_name VARCHAR(150),
    role VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'visor',
    -- admin | gerente | director_obra | residente | almacenista
    -- contador | rrhh | operador | conductor | visor
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    avatar VARCHAR(200),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    is_staff BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE,
    date_joined TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- ADMINISTRATION
CREATE TABLE administration_client (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    client_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, -- publico | privado | persona_natural
    nit VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    contact_person VARCHAR(150),
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    email VARCHAR(254),
    address VARCHAR(300),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE administration_contractor (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    nit VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    specialty VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- concreto | electricidad | plomeria | movimiento_tierras | pavimento
    -- geotecnia | topografia | acabados | prefabricados | otro
    contact_person VARCHAR(150),
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    email VARCHAR(254),
    address VARCHAR(300),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- PROJECTS
CREATE TABLE projects_project (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    project_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    -- vias | movimiento_tierras | infraestructura | residencial | comercial | mixto
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'adjudicado',
    -- licitacion | adjudicado | en_ejecucion | suspendido | terminado | liquidado
    description TEXT,
    location VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    municipality VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    department VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE NOT NULL,
    contract_value NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL,
    advance_percentage NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    director_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    resident_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE projects_projectphase (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'pendiente', -- pendiente | en_ejecucion | terminada
    budget NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    progress NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE projects_projectdocument (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    doc_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- contrato | plano | especificacion | acta | informe | permiso | otro
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    file VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    uploaded_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    notes TEXT
);

-- LOGS (Bitácoras)
CREATE TABLE logs_dailylog (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    weather_morning VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'soleado',
    weather_afternoon VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'soleado',
    -- soleado | nublado | lluvia_leve | lluvia_fuerte | tormenta
    temperature_min NUMERIC(5,1),
    temperature_max NUMERIC(5,1),
    general_notes TEXT,
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    UNIQUE(project_id, date)
);

CREATE TABLE logs_logactivity (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    daily_log_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    location VARCHAR(200),
    quantity NUMERIC(12,2),
    unit VARCHAR(30),
    start_time TIME,
    end_time TIME,
    progress_percentage NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    observations TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE logs_logpersonnel (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    daily_log_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    hours_worked NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 8,
    extra_hours NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    task VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    observations TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE logs_logequipment (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    daily_log_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_equipment(id),
    operator_id BIGINT REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    hours_operated NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0,
    hours_idle NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0,
    activity VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    initial_hourmeter NUMERIC(10,1),
    final_hourmeter NUMERIC(10,1),
    fuel_consumed NUMERIC(8,2),
    observations TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE logs_logmaterial (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    daily_log_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    material_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_material(id),
    quantity_used NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL,
    unit VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    activity VARCHAR(200),
    observations TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE logs_logincident (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    daily_log_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    incident_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- accidente | incidente | casi_accidente | seguridad | ambiental | calidad | otro
    severity VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, -- leve | moderado | grave | critico
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    location VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    persons_involved TEXT,
    immediate_actions TEXT,
    reported_to VARCHAR(200),
    time TIME
);

-- EQUIPMENT
CREATE TABLE equipment_equipment (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    equipment_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL,
    -- excavadora | bulldozer | motoniveladora | compactador | retroexcavadora
    -- cargador | grua | concretera | bomba_concreto | camion_volqueta
    -- camion_cisterna | camion_mixer | camion_plataforma | camioneta | otro
    brand VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    model VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    year INTEGER,
    serial_number VARCHAR(100),
    plate VARCHAR(20),
    capacity VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'disponible',
    -- disponible | asignado | mantenimiento | dañado | inactivo
    ownership VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'propio', -- propio | alquilado | leasing
    purchase_date DATE,
    purchase_value NUMERIC(16,2),
    current_hourmeter NUMERIC(10,1) DEFAULT 0,
    current_mileage NUMERIC(12,1) DEFAULT 0,
    fuel_type VARCHAR(20),
    insurance_expiry DATE,
    technical_review_expiry DATE,
    notes TEXT,
    photo VARCHAR(200),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE equipment_equipmentassignment (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_equipment(id),
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    operator_id BIGINT REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE,
    status VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'activo', -- activo | finalizado | cancelado
    daily_rate NUMERIC(12,2),
    notes TEXT,
    assigned_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id)
);

CREATE TABLE equipment_equipmentmaintenance (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_equipment(id),
    maintenance_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- preventivo | correctivo | predictivo | cambio_aceite | revision_general
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'programado',
    -- programado | en_proceso | completado | cancelado
    scheduled_date DATE NOT NULL,
    completion_date DATE,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    performed_by VARCHAR(200),
    cost NUMERIC(14,2),
    hourmeter_at_maintenance NUMERIC(10,1),
    next_maintenance_hourmeter NUMERIC(10,1),
    next_maintenance_date DATE,
    parts_replaced TEXT,
    notes TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE equipment_fuellog (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    equipment_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES equipment_equipment(id),
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    gallons NUMERIC(8,2) NOT NULL,
    unit_cost NUMERIC(10,2) NOT NULL,
    total_cost NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    hourmeter NUMERIC(10,1),
    mileage NUMERIC(12,1),
    fuel_station VARCHAR(150),
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    filled_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    notes TEXT
);

-- WAREHOUSE
CREATE TABLE warehouse_materialcategory (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_material (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    description TEXT,
    category_id BIGINT REFERENCES warehouse_materialcategory(id),
    unit VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    unit_price NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    current_stock NUMERIC(14,3) DEFAULT 0,
    minimum_stock NUMERIC(14,3) DEFAULT 0,
    maximum_stock NUMERIC(14,3),
    location VARCHAR(100),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_supplier (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    nit VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    contact_person VARCHAR(150),
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    email VARCHAR(254),
    address VARCHAR(300),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_purchaseorder (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    order_number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    supplier_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_supplier(id),
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'borrador',
    -- borrador | enviada | aprobada | recibida_parcial | recibida | cancelada
    order_date DATE NOT NULL,
    expected_delivery DATE,
    delivery_address VARCHAR(300),
    subtotal NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0,
    tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 19,
    tax_amount NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0,
    notes TEXT,
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_purchaseorderitem (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    purchase_order_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_purchaseorder(id),
    material_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_material(id),
    quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL,
    unit_price NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    total NUMERIC(16,2) NOT NULL,
    quantity_received NUMERIC(12,3) DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_materialentry (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    material_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_material(id),
    quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL,
    unit_price NUMERIC(14,2),
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    purchase_order_id BIGINT REFERENCES warehouse_purchaseorder(id),
    supplier_id BIGINT REFERENCES warehouse_supplier(id),
    invoice_number VARCHAR(50),
    received_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
    -- SIDE EFFECT: material.current_stock += quantity
);

CREATE TABLE warehouse_materialexit (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    material_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES warehouse_material(id),
    quantity NUMERIC(12,3) NOT NULL,
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    reason VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    authorized_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    daily_log_id BIGINT REFERENCES logs_dailylog(id),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
    -- SIDE EFFECT: material.current_stock -= quantity
);

-- PERSONNEL
CREATE TABLE personnel_department (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    description TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE personnel_position (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
    department_id BIGINT REFERENCES personnel_department(id),
    description TEXT,
    base_salary NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0
);

CREATE TABLE personnel_employee (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    first_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    last_name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    id_type VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'cc', -- cc | ce | pasaporte | nit
    id_number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    birth_date DATE,
    blood_type VARCHAR(3),
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    email VARCHAR(254),
    address VARCHAR(300),
    city VARCHAR(100),
    emergency_contact VARCHAR(150),
    emergency_phone VARCHAR(20),
    department_id BIGINT REFERENCES personnel_department(id),
    position_id BIGINT REFERENCES personnel_position(id),
    hire_date DATE NOT NULL,
    termination_date DATE,
    salary_type VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'fijo', -- fijo | variable | jornal | honorarios
    base_salary NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'activo',
    -- activo | vacaciones | licencia | incapacidad | retirado
    eps VARCHAR(100),
    arl VARCHAR(100),
    pension_fund VARCHAR(100),
    photo VARCHAR(200),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE personnel_employeedocument (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    doc_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- contrato | cedula | hoja_vida | certificado | examen_medico | otro
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    file VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    expiry_date DATE,
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    notes TEXT
);

-- PAYROLL (Colombian model)
CREATE TABLE payroll_payrollperiod (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    period_type VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'mensual', -- quincenal | mensual
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE NOT NULL,
    payment_date DATE,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'abierto',
    -- abierto | procesando | cerrado | pagado
    total_devengado NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_deducciones NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_neto NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE payroll_payrollentry (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    period_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES payroll_payrollperiod(id),
    employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    days_worked NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 30,
    regular_hours NUMERIC(6,2) DEFAULT 0,
    extra_hours_day NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    extra_hours_night NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    extra_hours_holiday NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    -- DEVENGADO
    base_salary NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    transportation_allowance NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    extra_pay NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    bonuses NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    vacation_pay NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_devengado NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    -- DEDUCCIONES EMPLEADO
    health_deduction NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,   -- 4%
    pension_deduction NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,  -- 4%
    other_deductions NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    advances NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total_deductions NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    -- NETO
    net_pay NUMERIC(14,2) DEFAULT 0,
    -- APORTES PATRONALES
    employer_health NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,   -- 8.5%
    employer_pension NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,  -- 12%
    arl NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,               -- variable por riesgo
    ccf NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,               -- 4%
    icbf NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,              -- 3%
    sena NUMERIC(12,2) DEFAULT 0,              -- 2%
    notes TEXT,
    UNIQUE(period_id, employee_id)
);

CREATE TABLE payroll_salaryadvance (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    employee_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES personnel_employee(id),
    amount NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    request_date DATE NOT NULL,
    reason TEXT,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'pendiente',
    -- pendiente | aprobado | rechazado | descontado
    approved_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    payroll_entry_id BIGINT REFERENCES payroll_payrollentry(id),
    notes TEXT
);

-- ACCOUNTING
CREATE TABLE accounting_account (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(20) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL,
    account_type VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL,
    -- activo | pasivo | patrimonio | ingreso | gasto | costo
    parent_id BIGINT REFERENCES accounting_account(id),
    is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE,
    description TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_journal (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    date DATE NOT NULL,
    description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'borrador',
    -- borrador | contabilizado | anulado
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
    reference VARCHAR(100),
    notes TEXT
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_journalentry (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    journal_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounting_journal(id),
    account_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounting_account(id),
    description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    debit NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0,
    credit NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0
    -- CONSTRAINT: SUM(debit) == SUM(credit) per journal (enforced in app layer)
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_invoice (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_number VARCHAR(30) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    invoice_type VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'factura',
    -- factura | anticipo | acta_cobro
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    client_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES administration_client(id),
    issue_date DATE NOT NULL,
    due_date DATE NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'borrador',
    -- borrador | enviada | pagada_parcial | pagada | vencida | anulada
    subtotal NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    tax_rate NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 19,
    tax_amount NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    retention NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    total NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    paid_amount NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    notes TEXT,
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_invoiceitem (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    invoice_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES accounting_invoice(id),
    description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    unit VARCHAR(30),
    quantity NUMERIC(12,3) DEFAULT 1,
    unit_price NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL,
    total NUMERIC(16,2) NOT NULL
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_expense (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    -- materiales | mano_obra | equipos | combustible | transporte
    -- subcontrato | administrativo | seguridad | otro
    description VARCHAR(300) NOT NULL,
    amount NUMERIC(16,2) NOT NULL,
    expense_date DATE NOT NULL,
    supplier_id BIGINT REFERENCES warehouse_supplier(id),
    invoice_number VARCHAR(50),
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'pendiente',
    -- pendiente | aprobado | rechazado | pagado
    receipt VARCHAR(200),
    requested_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    approved_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    notes TEXT,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE accounting_budget (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    budgeted_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL,
    actual_amount NUMERIC(18,2) DEFAULT 0,
    notes TEXT,
    UNIQUE(project_id, category)
);

CREATE TABLE administration_contract (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    contract_number VARCHAR(50) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
    contract_type VARCHAR(15) NOT NULL,
    -- principal | subcontrato | suministro | servicio
    project_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES projects_project(id),
    client_id BIGINT REFERENCES administration_client(id),
    contractor_id BIGINT REFERENCES administration_contractor(id),
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    start_date DATE NOT NULL,
    end_date DATE NOT NULL,
    value NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL,
    advance_percentage NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 0,
    retention_percentage NUMERIC(5,2) DEFAULT 10,
    status VARCHAR(15) DEFAULT 'borrador',
    -- borrador | revision | firmado | en_ejecucion | terminado | liquidado | anulado
    contract_file VARCHAR(200),
    signed_date DATE,
    notes TEXT,
    created_by_id BIGINT REFERENCES users_user(id),
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE administration_contractaddendum (
    id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    contract_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES administration_contract(id),
    number INTEGER NOT NULL,
    description TEXT NOT NULL,
    value_change NUMERIC(16,2) DEFAULT 0,
    days_change INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
    signed_date DATE NOT NULL,
    file VARCHAR(200),
    notes TEXT,
    UNIQUE(contract_id, number)
);
```

## Section 5 — API Design

### Base URL
```
Development:  http://localhost:8000/api/
Production:   https://construgestion.example.com/api/
```

### Authentication
```
POST /api/auth/login/
Body:    { "username": "string", "password": "string" }
Returns: { "access": "eyJ...", "refresh": "eyJ..." }

POST /api/auth/refresh/
Body:    { "refresh": "eyJ..." }
Returns: { "access": "eyJ..." }

All protected endpoints require:
Header: Authorization: Bearer {access_token}
```

### Pagination (all list endpoints)
```json
{
  "count": 47,
  "next": "/api/projects/projects/?page=3",
  "previous": "/api/projects/projects/?page=1",
  "results": [...]
}
Default page size: 20
```

### Complete Endpoint Map

```
USERS           /api/
  GET/POST        users/
  GET/PATCH/DEL   users/{id}/
  GET/PATCH       users/me/
  POST            users/change_password/

PROJECTS        /api/projects/
  CRUD            projects/
  GET             projects/{id}/summary/      → KPIs aggregation
  CRUD            phases/
  CRUD            documents/

DAILY LOGS      /api/logs/
  CRUD            daily-logs/                 → 1 per project per day
  CRUD            activities/
  CRUD            log-personnel/
  CRUD            log-equipment/
  CRUD            log-materials/
  CRUD            incidents/

EQUIPMENT       /api/equipment/
  CRUD            equipment/
  GET             equipment/{id}/history/     → assignments + maintenance + fuel
  CRUD            assignments/
  CRUD            maintenance/
  CRUD            fuel-logs/

WAREHOUSE       /api/warehouse/
  CRUD            categories/
  CRUD            materials/
  GET             materials/low_stock/        → stock <= minimum_stock
  CRUD            suppliers/
  CRUD            purchase-orders/
  CRUD            entries/                    → auto increments stock
  CRUD            exits/                      → auto decrements stock

PERSONNEL       /api/personnel/
  CRUD            departments/
  CRUD            positions/
  CRUD            employees/
  CRUD            employee-documents/

PAYROLL         /api/payroll/
  CRUD            periods/
  GET             periods/{id}/summary/       → totals aggregation
  CRUD            entries/
  CRUD            advances/

ACCOUNTING      /api/accounting/
  CRUD            accounts/                   → tree structure (parent FK)
  CRUD            journals/
  CRUD            invoices/
  GET             invoices/overdue/           → due_date < today, unpaid
  CRUD            expenses/
  CRUD            budgets/

ADMINISTRATION  /api/admin/
  CRUD            clients/
  CRUD            contractors/
  CRUD            contracts/
  CRUD            addenda/

DASHBOARD       /api/dashboard/              → consolidated KPIs
DOCS            /api/docs/                   → Swagger UI (drf-spectacular)
SCHEMA          /api/schema/                 → OpenAPI JSON
```

### Key Response Shapes

```json
// GET /api/dashboard/
{
  "projects": {
    "active": 3,
    "by_status": [{"status": "en_ejecucion", "count": 3}],
    "total_contract_value": 25500000000.0
  },
  "equipment": {
    "by_status": [{"status": "disponible", "count": 3}, {"status": "asignado", "count": 4}]
  },
  "personnel": { "active_employees": 6 },

  "financial": {
    "monthly_invoiced": 2400000000.0,
    "monthly_expenses": 115150000.0,
    "overdue_invoices": 1
  },
  "recent_logs": [{"id": 10, "project": "Vía Granada", "project_code": "PRY-2024-001", "date": "2026-05-25"}],
  "recent_incidents": [{"id": 1, "project": "Vía Granada", "type": "Casi Accidente", "severity": "leve", "date": "2026-05-25"}]
}
```

### Filtering & Search
Every list endpoint supports:
```
?search=          full-text search on key fields
?page=            pagination
?ordering=        e.g. ?ordering=-created_at
?field=value      exact filter via django-filter
```

## Section 6 — Frontend Architecture

### Page Map
```
/login              → Login.tsx           (public)
/                   → Dashboard.tsx        KPIs + recent activity
/projects           → ProjectList.tsx      Table with search
/projects/:id       → ProjectDetail.tsx    (Phase 2)
/logs               → LogList.tsx          Table with date filter
/logs/:id           → LogDetail.tsx        (Phase 2)
/logs/new           → LogForm.tsx          (Phase 2)
/equipment          → EquipmentList.tsx    Table with status filter
/equipment/:id      → EquipmentDetail.tsx  (Phase 2)
/warehouse          → WarehouseList.tsx    Inventory + low stock toggle
/personnel          → PersonnelList.tsx    Employee table
/payroll            → PayrollList.tsx      Period list
/accounting         → AccountingList.tsx   Invoices + expenses summary
/administration     → AdministrationList.tsx  Clients + contractors
```

### State Architecture
```
Server State (TanStack Query)     Global State (Zustand)
──────────────────────────────    ──────────────────────
queryKey: ['projects']            authStore:
queryKey: ['daily-logs', search]    - user: User | null
queryKey: ['equipment']             - isAuthenticated: bool
queryKey: ['materials']             - setUser(user)
queryKey: ['employees']             - logout()
queryKey: ['dashboard']
  └── refetchInterval: 60s
```

### Component Hierarchy
```
App
├── BrowserRouter
│   ├── QueryClientProvider
│   │   ├── /login → Login
│   │   └── PrivateRoute → Layout
│   │       ├── Sidebar (fixed left, 64px wide)
│   │       └── main (ml-64, overflow-auto)
│   │           └── <Outlet /> → Page components
│   │               ├── StatCard (KPI tile)
│   │               ├── Card / CardHeader / CardBody
│   │               ├── Badge (status label)
│   │               └── [data table]
```

### Data Flow Pattern (per page)
```typescript
// Standard list page pattern
const { data, isLoading } = useQuery({
  queryKey: ['resource', filters],
  queryFn: () => api.get('/endpoint/', { params: filters }).then(r => r.data),
})
// Renders: loading state → empty state → data table
```

## Section 8 — Auth & Authorization

### Login Flow
```
1. User POST /api/auth/login/ → { access, refresh }
2. Store both tokens in localStorage
3. Axios interceptor attaches: Authorization: Bearer {access}
4. On 401: interceptor tries POST /api/auth/refresh/
5. If refresh valid → store new access, retry original request
6. If refresh expired → clear localStorage, redirect /login
7. access lifetime: 8 hours
8. refresh lifetime: 7 days (rotates on use)
```

### Roles
```
admin         Full access to everything
gerente       Read all + write projects/contracts
director_obra Write projects, logs, equipment, expenses
residente     Write logs, read everything else
almacenista   Full warehouse CRUD
contador      Full accounting/payroll CRUD
rrhh          Full personnel/payroll CRUD
operador      Read equipment + write fuel logs
conductor     Read equipment only
visor         Read-only on all modules
```

### Permission Enforcement
- Backend: `IsAuthenticated` on all viewsets (DRF default)
- Object-level permissions: extend with `BasePermission` in Phase 2
- Frontend: role-based nav (hide menu items), `PrivateRoute` for auth gate
- Sensitive operations (payroll close, journal post): role-check in view

## Section 9 — Build Order

> **This is the most important section.** Follow this order exactly.
> Each step is independently testable before proceeding.

### PMI Process Group Mapping (PMBOK 6)

Each build phase maps to one of the 5 PMBOK Process Groups. The software build IS the Executing group; the surrounding activities are the others.

| PMBOK Process Group | Build Steps | Key ITTOs |
|---------------------|-------------|-----------|
| **Initiating** | Steps 1–2 (setup, user model) | Project Charter → Repository + Stack decision |
| **Planning** | Steps 3–4 (config, admin module) | WBS → Section 3 Directory Structure; Risk Register → Section 13 rules |
| **Executing** | Steps 5–19 (all module builds + frontend) | Quality Assurance → `python manage.py check` + `tsc -b` at each step |
| **Monitoring & Controlling** | Steps 20–21 (Docker + seed) | EVM tracking, QA checklist from Section 13 |
| **Closing** | Post Step 21 (production deploy, handoff) | Lessons Learned, Benefits Realization baseline |

### PMBOK 7 Performance Domains active during build

| Domain | How It Applies |
|--------|---------------|
| Stakeholders | Director de Obra reviews each module UI before next step |
| Team | Solo or pair — apply XP practices: small commits, immediate test |
| Development Approach | Adaptive (sprint per module) within predictive overall plan |
| Planning | Section 3 directory structure = WBS decomposed to file level |
| Project Work | Each STEP below = Work Package with clear Done criterion |
| Delivery | Each step outputs a working, testable increment |
| Measurement | `python manage.py check` + `tsc -b` are control points |
| Uncertainty | Risk: FK dependency order (solved by fixed build sequence) |

### PMBOK 8 Principles applied

| Principle | Application |
|-----------|-------------|
| Stewardship | Never commit secrets; use `.env.example`; no float for money |
| Team | Document AUTH_USER_MODEL constraint before anyone runs migrate |
| Stakeholders | Demo each module to Director de Obra before next module |
| Value | Each step delivers a testable increment — no big-bang integration |
| Systems Thinking | All apps share the same User model; FK order is a system constraint |
| Leadership | Section 16 rules are non-negotiable — enforce them without exception |

```bash
# 1.1 Repository
git init construgestion
cd construgestion
git checkout -b develop

# 1.2 Backend
mkdir backend && cd backend
python -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate
pip install django djangorestframework djangorestframework-simplejwt \
  django-cors-headers django-filter drf-spectacular Pillow \
  psycopg2-binary python-decouple gunicorn
django-admin startproject config .

# 1.3 Create all apps at once
python manage.py startapp users
python manage.py startapp projects
python manage.py startapp logs
python manage.py startapp equipment
python manage.py startapp warehouse
python manage.py startapp personnel
python manage.py startapp payroll
python manage.py startapp accounting
python manage.py startapp administration

# 1.4 Frontend
cd .. && npm create vite@latest frontend -- --template react-ts
cd frontend
npm install axios react-router-dom @tanstack/react-query \
  react-hook-form @hookform/resolvers zod zustand \
  lucide-react date-fns recharts
npm install -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite

# 1.5 Docker
```

## Section 10 — Environment Setup

### Prerequisites
```
- Python 3.12+
- Node.js 20+
- PostgreSQL 16+ (or Docker)
- Git
```

### Local Development (without Docker)
```bash
# 1. Clone
git clone <repo-url>
cd construgestion

# 2. Backend
cd backend
python -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate          # Windows: venv\Scripts\activate
pip install -r requirements.txt

# 3. Create database (PostgreSQL must be running)
createdb construction_db          # or: sudo -u postgres psql -c "CREATE DATABASE construction_db"
# Create user with password, grant privileges

# 4. Environment
cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env: DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, etc.

# 5. Migrate + seed
python manage.py migrate
python create_superuser.py
python manage.py loaddata fixtures/initial_data.json

# 6. Run backend
python manage.py runserver 8000

# 7. Frontend (new terminal)
cd ../frontend
npm install
npm run dev                       # → localhost:5173
```

```bash
docker compose up -d              # starts db + backend + frontend
# Access:
# Frontend: http://localhost:5173
# API:      http://localhost:8000/api/
# Docs:     http://localhost:8000/api/docs/
# Admin:    http://localhost:8000/admin/
```

## Section 12 — Deployment

### Staging / Production Architecture
```
Internet → Nginx (443 HTTPS)
              ├── /           → serve React static build (dist/)
              ├── /api/       → proxy → Gunicorn:8000 (Django)
              └── /media/     → serve uploaded files
```

### Docker Production
```yaml
# docker-compose.prod.yml additions
services:
  backend:
    command: gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:8000 --workers 4
    environment:
      DEBUG: "False"
      ALLOWED_HOSTS: "construgestion.example.com"
  
  nginx:
    image: nginx:alpine
    ports: ["80:80", "443:443"]
    volumes:
      - ./frontend/nginx.conf:/etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
      - ./certbot/conf:/etc/letsencrypt
      - static_files:/app/staticfiles
      - media_files:/app/media
```

### CI/CD (GitHub Actions)
```yaml
# .github/workflows/deploy.yml
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  deploy:
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Type check frontend
        run: cd frontend && npm ci && npx tsc -b
      - name: Django check
        run: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && python manage.py check
      - name: Build & push Docker images
        run: docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml build && docker compose push
      - name: Deploy via SSH
        run: ssh deploy@server "cd /app && docker compose pull && docker compose up -d"
```

### SSL / Domain
```bash
# Certbot for Let's Encrypt
docker run -it --rm \
  -v ./certbot/conf:/etc/letsencrypt \
  certbot/certbot certonly --webroot \
  -w /var/www/html -d construgestion.example.com
```

### Database Backups
```bash
# Automated daily backup (cron)
0 2 * * * pg_dump construction_db | gzip > /backups/db_$(date +%Y%m%d).sql.gz
# Keep 30 days, sync to S3 or similar
```

```python
# Use pytest + pytest-django
# Run: pytest backend/ -v --cov=. --cov-report=html

# Priority test areas:
# 1. Model constraints (unique_together, FK integrity)
# 2. Stock update side effects (MaterialEntry/Exit)
# 3. JWT authentication flow
# 4. API endpoint permissions (each role)
# 5. Dashboard aggregation correctness

# Example: test stock update
def test_material_entry_updates_stock(db, material, user):
    initial = material.current_stock
    client.post('/api/warehouse/entries/', {
        'material': material.id, 'quantity': 50, 'date': '2026-01-01'
    })
    material.refresh_from_db()
    assert material.current_stock == initial + 50
```

### Manual QA Checklist (before each release)
```
[ ] Login / Logout / Token refresh
[ ] Create project → create daily log → add activity + incident
[ ] Create material → entry (stock increases) → exit (stock decreases)
[ ] Create employee → create payroll period → add payroll entry
[ ] Create client → create invoice → mark as paid
[ ] Dashboard KPIs update after creating data
[ ] Low stock alert appears when stock ≤ minimum
[ ] Overdue invoices appear in /invoices/overdue/
[ ] All 9 module list pages load without errors
[ ] Swagger docs at /api/docs/ show all endpoints
```

### Performance Targets
```
API response time (p95):  < 300ms
Dashboard load:           < 1s
Frontend bundle:          < 500KB gzip
Database queries/request: < 10 (use select_related, prefetch_related)
```

### EVM — Earned Value Management (PMBOK 6 §7.4 / PMBOK 8 Dominio Financiero)

Track build progress using EVM. Each STEP in Section 9 = one Work Package.

**Baseline:**
- Total Planned Value (PV) = 21 steps × estimated effort
- Budget at Completion (BAC) = total approved development hours

**Key Formulas:**

| Formula | Expression | Meaning |
|---------|-----------|---------|
| SV (Schedule Variance) | EV − PV | Negative = behind schedule |
| CV (Cost Variance) | EV − AC | Negative = over budget |
| SPI (Schedule Performance Index) | EV / PV | < 1.0 = behind |
| CPI (Cost Performance Index) | EV / AC | < 1.0 = over cost |
| EAC (Estimate at Completion) | BAC / CPI | Projected final cost |
| ETC (Estimate to Complete) | EAC − AC | Remaining work cost |
| TCPI | (BAC − EV) / (BAC − AC) | Efficiency needed to finish on budget |
| VAC (Variance at Completion) | BAC − EAC | Positive = under budget |

**Thresholds for escalation:**
- CPI < 0.85 → escalate to Gerente General
- SPI < 0.80 → add resource or reduce scope
- Both < 0.80 → invoke change control process

**Dashboard KPI alignment** — the ConstruGestión dashboard directly supports EVM:

| Dashboard KPI | EVM Element |
|--------------|-------------|
| `invoiced_month` | Actual Cost (AC) proxy |
| `expenses_month` | Cost component for CPI |
| Overdue invoices | Schedule risk indicator |
| Active projects count | Scope baseline tracker |

### Risk Register (PMBOK 6 §11 / PMBOK 8 Dominio Incertidumbre)

| Risk | Probability | Impact | Strategy | Owner |
|------|------------|--------|----------|-------|
| AUTH_USER_MODEL changed after first migrate | Low | Very High | Avoid — build Users first (Step 2) | Dev |
| Float used for money fields | Medium | High | Avoid — rule enforced in Section 16 | Dev |
| N+1 queries on list views | High | Medium | Mitigate — select_related required | Dev |
| Colombian payroll rates change | Medium | High | Transfer — parameterize rates in model constants | RRHH |
| PostgreSQL unavailable in prod | Low | Very High | Mitigate — Docker Compose with health checks | DevOps |
| Scope creep beyond 9 modules | Medium | Medium | Avoid — Section 16 rules prohibit unplanned features | Gerente |

## Section 14 — PMI/PMBOK Project Management Framework

> This section maps the ConstruGestión system to the PMI body of knowledge across all three active PMBOK editions. Use it to align development decisions with internationally recognized PM standards.

---

### PMBOK 6 — Process-Based Framework (2017)
**Structure:** 5 Process Groups × 10 Knowledge Areas = 49 Processes

#### 5 Process Groups applied to ConstruGestión development

| Process Group | Purpose | ConstruGestión Milestone |
|---------------|---------|-------------------------|
| **Initiating** | Authorize the project | Blueprint approved, branch created, team assigned |
| **Planning** | Define what to build and how | Section 3 (WBS), Section 4 (data model), Section 9 (build order) |
| **Executing** | Build the deliverables | Steps 2–19 of Section 9 |
| **Monitoring & Controlling** | Measure, compare, correct | EVM tracking, `python manage.py check`, `tsc -b`, QA checklist |
| **Closing** | Formal acceptance | Production deploy, Docker Compose verified, benefits baseline set |

#### 10 Knowledge Areas → ConstruGestión mapping

| Knowledge Area | PMBOK 6 Section | ConstruGestión Element |
|---------------|----------------|----------------------|
| Integration | §4 | Blueprint itself; Section 15 CLAUDE.md as Project Management Plan |
| Scope | §5 | 9 modules, 39 entities, Section 3 directory structure (WBS) |
| Schedule | §6 | Build Order Steps 1–21; one step per Work Package |
| Cost | §7 | EVM in Section 13; Budget model in accounting app |
| Quality | §8 | `manage.py check`, `tsc -b`, Section 16 rules, QA checklist |
| Resource | §9 | Stakeholder Register in Section 1; roles in users/models.py |
| Communications | §10 | Swagger UI at /api/docs/, Django Admin, dashboard KPIs |
| Risk | §11 | Risk Register in Section 13; migration order is top-priority risk |
| Procurement | §12 | Contractor and PurchaseOrder models in administration/warehouse |
| Stakeholders | §13 | Stakeholder Register in Section 1; role-based permissions in system |

#### Key ITTOs for this project

**Inputs consumed:**
- OPAs: Colombian labor law, PUC chart of accounts, equipment maintenance templates
- EEFs: DIAN regulations, PostgreSQL infrastructure, existing company workflows

**Tools & Techniques used:**
- Decomposition → Section 3 directory = WBS
- Expert Judgment → Django/React architecture decisions
- Data Analysis → EVM formulas (Section 13)
- Meetings → Module demos after each Step

**Outputs produced:**
- Project Charter → this Blueprint document
- WBS → Section 3 directory structure
- Risk Register → Section 13 Risk Register table
- Quality Metrics → Section 13 Performance Targets + EVM thresholds

### PMBOK 7 — Principle-Based Framework (2021)
**Structure:** 12 Principles + 8 Performance Domains (outcome-oriented, not process-prescriptive)

#### 12 Principles → ConstruGestión decisions

| # | Principle | Applied Decision |
|---|-----------|----------------|
| 1 | Be a diligent, respectful, trustworthy steward | No float for money; no secrets in git; ACID transactions |
| 2 | Create a collaborative project team environment | Section 15 CLAUDE.md shared with all contributors |
| 3 | Effectively engage with stakeholders | Module demo to Director de Obra before proceeding |
| 4 | Focus on value | Each Step delivers a testable, working increment |
| 5 | Recognize, evaluate, and respond to system interactions | FK build order — Users before Projects before Logs |
| 6 | Demonstrate leadership behaviors | Section 16 rules enforced non-negotiably |
| 7 | Tailor based on context | Colombian locale (es-co, America/Bogota, COP currency) |
| 8 | Build quality into processes and deliverables | `select_related` required, no magic numbers, `__str__` on all models |
| 9 | Navigate complexity | 39 entities managed via 9 isolated Django apps |
| 10 | Optimize risk responses | Migration order locks in Step 2 (avoid catastrophic risk) |
| 11 | Embrace adaptability and resiliency | Modular app structure allows adding modules without refactoring core |
| 12 | Enable change to achieve the envisioned future state | Phase 2 extensions (mobile, DIAN e-invoicing) don't break Phase 1 |

#### 8 Performance Domains → development health checks

| Domain | Health Indicator | Green Threshold |
|--------|-----------------|----------------|
| Stakeholders | Director de Obra sign-off per module | All 9 modules signed off before production |
| Team | Build velocity (steps/week) | ≥ 2 steps/week |
| Development Approach | Adaptive within predictive | Sprint per module, each step testable |
| Planning | WBS coverage | 100% of files in Section 3 exist |
| Project Work | Step completion rate | Each Step passes its Verify check |
| Delivery | Functional increments | Dashboard live after Step 12 |
| Measurement | EVM indicators | CPI ≥ 0.85, SPI ≥ 0.80 |
| Uncertainty | Open risk count | ≤ 2 HIGH risks open at any time |

---

### PMBOK 8 — Unified Principles Framework (2024)
**Structure:** 6 Refined Principles + 7 Domains + 5 Focus Areas + 40 Processes

#### 6 PMBOK 8 Principles

| Principle | Meaning for ConstruGestión |
|-----------|--------------------------|
| **Gobernanza efectiva** | Section 16 rules + role-based permissions enforce project governance |
| **Valor sostenible** | System designed to last: Docker, migrations, no magic numbers |
| **Compromiso de los interesados** | Stakeholder register drives UAT; roles drive UI access |
| **Desempeño holístico** | Dashboard aggregates all 9 modules into one KPI view |
| **Pensamiento sistémico** | FK dependencies, shared User model, atomic stock updates |
| **Adaptación continua** | Settings via `.env`, modular apps, fixtures for reference data |

#### 7 PMBOK 8 Domains → ConstruGestión modules

| PMBOK 8 Domain | ConstruGestión Module(s) | Key Deliverable |
|----------------|------------------------|----------------|
| **Interesados** (Stakeholders) | Users + Administration | Role-based auth, client/contractor registry |
| **Equipo** (Team) | Personnel + Payroll | Employee records, Colombian payroll calculations |
| **Desarrollo y entrega** (Delivery) | Projects + Logs + Equipment | Daily logs, project phases, equipment tracking |
| **Planificación** (Planning) | Projects (phases) + Budget | ProjectPhase model, Budget model |
| **Trabajo del proyecto** (Project Work) | Warehouse + Equipment | PurchaseOrders, MaterialEntry/Exit, maintenance logs |
| **Financiero** (Financial) | Accounting | Chart of accounts, invoices, expenses, EVM metrics |
| **Gobernanza** (Governance) | Admin panel + Users (roles) | 10 roles, permission-per-endpoint, audit trail via DailyLog |

#### 5 PMBOK 8 Focus Areas

| Focus Area | Application |

# ConstruGestión — Build Instructions

## What You Are Building
A full-stack enterprise management system for construction companies.
Backend: Django 5 + PostgreSQL. Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS v4.

## Architecture
- Backend lives in /backend/ — Django project with 9 apps
- Frontend lives in /frontend/ — React SPA
- PostgreSQL database (connection via .env)
- JWT authentication (access: 8h, refresh: 7d)

## Critical Rules
1. NEVER run migrations before AUTH_USER_MODEL = 'users.User' is set in settings.py
2. ALWAYS use transaction.atomic() when updating material stock
3. DailyLog has unique_together = ['project', 'date'] — enforce this
4. Money fields use NUMERIC(x,2) — never float
5. Colombian payroll rules: health=4%, pension=4% employee; 8.5%, 12%, ARL, CCF, ICBF, SENA employer

## Build Order
Follow Section 9 of the blueprint EXACTLY:
Step 1 → Step 2 (User model BEFORE first migrate) → Step 3 → Step 4 (Administration)
→ Step 5 (Projects) → Step 6 (Personnel) → Step 7 (Warehouse) → Step 8 (Equipment)
→ Step 9 (Logs) → Step 10 (Payroll) → Step 11 (Accounting) → Step 12 (Dashboard)
→ Step 13 (Fixtures) → Step 14 (API Docs) → Step 15-19 (Frontend)
→ Step 20 (Docker) → Step 21 (Seed data)

## Commands
```bash
# Backend
cd backend && source venv/bin/activate
python manage.py makemigrations && python manage.py migrate
python manage.py runserver 8000

# Frontend
cd frontend && npm run dev

# Check Django

# Test login
curl -X POST http://localhost:8000/api/auth/login/ \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"username":"admin","password":"Admin2024!"}'
```

- Username: admin / Password: Admin2024!
- Role: admin (full access to all modules)

## Module → URL Mapping
- Users:          /api/users/
- Projects:       /api/projects/projects/

- Equipment:      /api/equipment/equipment/
- Warehouse:      /api/warehouse/materials/

## Color System
- Sidebar:  #111827 (gray-900)
- Accent:   #FBBF24 (yellow-400) for buttons + active nav
- Success:  #10B981 (green-500)
- Danger:   #EF4444 (red-500)

## What NOT To Do
- Do NOT use float for money — always Decimal/NUMERIC
- Do NOT skip migrations — every model change needs makemigrations
- Do NOT use localStorage for sensitive business data (tokens only)
- Do NOT add features beyond the 9 defined modules without explicit request
- Do NOT create mock data in components — always call real API endpoints

```
## Section 16 — Rules

> Non-negotiable constraints for every line of code written.

### Data Integrity
1. **All monetary values use `NUMERIC(x,2)` / `DecimalField`** — never float, never integer
2. **Stock updates are always atomic** — `transaction.atomic()` on every MaterialEntry and MaterialExit
3. **DailyLog is unique per project per day** — one log per project per calendar date, no exceptions
4. **JournalEntry must balance** — sum of debits must equal sum of credits per Journal (enforce in serializer)
5. **PayrollEntry is unique per period per employee** — no duplicate payroll for same person same period

### Security
6. **All endpoints require authentication** — `IsAuthenticated` is the default, no public endpoints except `/auth/`
7. **JWT tokens stored only in localStorage** — never in cookies (CSRF risk) or URL params
8. **No SQL raw queries** — use Django ORM exclusively (parameterized, SQL injection safe)
9. **File uploads go to /media/** — never to /static/, validate file types in serializer

### Code Quality
10. **No magic numbers** — all choices use `_CHOICES` constants defined on the model
11. **No print() in production code** — use Django logger (`import logging; logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)`)
12. **All models have `__str__`** — required for Django Admin usability
13. **Related objects use `select_related` / `prefetch_related`** — never N+1 queries in list views
14. **TypeScript strict mode** — no `any` types in React code

### Business Rules (Colombia)
15. **Payroll employee deductions**: health = 4%, pension = 4% of devengado
16. **Payroll employer contributions**: health = 8.5%, pension = 12%, CCF = 4%, ICBF = 3%, SENA = 2%
17. **Default tax rate on invoices = 19%** (Colombian IVA)
18. **Default retention on contracts = 10%** (garantía de cumplimiento)
19. **Equipment codes are immutable** after creation — they appear on physical tags
20. **Material stock cannot go below 0** — validate before saving MaterialExit

### Architecture
21. **One Django app per business domain** — never mix project and payroll logic in the same app
22. **Frontend calls API only** — no direct DB access, no business logic in React components
23. **Dashboard is read-only aggregate** — it queries but never mutates data
24. **Fixtures for reference data** — departments, categories, chart of accounts loaded via `loaddata`, not hardcoded
25. **Docker for production** — all deployment uses Docker, never `python manage.py runserver` in prod

### PMI Governance (PMBOK 8 — Gobernanza Efectiva)
26. **This Blueprint IS the Project Management Plan** — any change to scope, schedule, or architecture requires updating this document first
27. **EVM thresholds are binding** — CPI < 0.85 or SPI < 0.80 triggers mandatory escalation, not optional review
28. **Benefits Realization is mandatory** — 6 months after go-live, measure the 5 success metrics from Section 1 against baseline
29. **Tailoring decisions are documented** — any PMBOK process omitted must have a written rationale (see Section 14 Tailoring table)
30. **Stakeholder sign-off required per module** — Director de Obra must approve each module before it is considered Done
```
